summary: Iteration 22 — Full E2E testing of new Attendance (Davamiyyət) and Barter modules for Marsol ERP. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests passed covering attendance upsert/bulk/stats, leave-requests CRUD + auto-attendance on approve, barter CRUD with auto barter_code generation and stats with net_balance, and RBAC (hr for attendance/leaves, finance for barters). Frontend: Attendance page (3 tabs daily/monthly/leaves), date navigation, leave modal, and Barter page (5 stat cards, add modal with blue/amber themed blocks) all render with expected data-testid selectors; sidebar and write-button RBAC correctly hides controls for accountant (no hr) and sales (no finance) users. Regression passes for Projects/Invitations/ContactLists/Finance/Employees/Meetings/Tasks.

minor.issue: Month range uses '%Y-%m-01' to '%Y-%m-31' string comparison which incorrectly includes dates like 2026-02-31 that don't exist. Works for lexicographic string sort but fragile for cross-month queries; consider computing last-day-of-month explicitly.

barter_code generated with count_documents({})+1 is NOT concurrency-safe and collides if two codes are created in parallel or if a barter is deleted (next code reuses an existing one). Use an atomic counter document (findOneAndUpdate $inc) or UUID.
No 404 on missing id — update_one matched_count=0 still returns the (None) doc. Should raise HTTPException(404) when id doesn't exist.
Do not check deleted_count — silently return 200 even when record doesn't exist. Should 404.
No validation that data['status'] is in ATTENDANCE_STATUSES; any arbitrary status string is accepted and later breaks the stats aggregation (bucket ignored silently).

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Accessibility issue — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to DialogContent in both Attendance.jsx and Barter.jsx.

RBAC: Accountant CAN POST /api/barters (finance write)
RBAC: Accountant CANNOT POST /api/attendance (no hr) — 401/403
RBAC: Sales CANNOT POST /api/attendance or /api/barters
Regression: /api/project-events, /api/event-invitations, /api/contact-lists, /api/finance/summary, /api/employees, /api/meetings, /api/tasks all return 200
Frontend /attendance renders [data-testid=attendance-page]; all 3 tabs (tab-daily/tab-monthly/tab-leaves) visible
Frontend date-picker + prev-day-btn + next-day-btn shift date correctly; 'Bu gün' resets to today
Frontend mark-all-btn visible for admin; status-select-{id} rendered per employee
Frontend tab-monthly renders month-picker

Frontend Barter modal shows our-service in bg-blue-50 block and their-service in bg-amber-50 block
Frontend Sidebar shows menu-attendance + menu-barter for admin

RBAC Frontend: Accountant /barter — add-barter-btn VISIBLE (finance write)
RBAC Frontend: Accountant /attendance — mark-all-btn HIDDEN, add-leave-btn HIDDEN

action_items: MINOR: Replace barter_code count_documents+1 with atomic counter to avoid duplicate codes on concurrent creates or after deletes
MINOR: Add 404 on missing id for PUT /api/leave-requests/{id}, DELETE /api/barters/{id}, DELETE /api/attendance/{id}, DELETE /api/leave-requests/{id}
MINOR: Validate ATTENDANCE_STATUSES on POST /api/attendance and LEAVE_STATUSES/BARTER_STATUSES on their writes
A11Y: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to DialogContent in Attendance.jsx and Barter.jsx to silence Radix warning
CODE QUALITY: /app/backend/server.py is 3121 lines — split into routers (attendance.py, leaves.py, barters.py, finance.py, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: barter_code uniqueness is racy (count_documents + zfill). On delete, next insert reuses an existing code — can corrupt stats and foreign references.

Leave approve auto-fill overwrites existing attendance records unconditionally — if employee already had 'İşdə' on a day later covered by approved leave, it silently flips to 'Məzuniyyət' with no audit trail. Consider skipping already-populated days or logging the overwrite.
Attendance stats month filter uses string '%Y-%m-31' as upper bound which works due to ISO-date lex order but is semantically incorrect — use dateutil.relativedelta + next-month-01 exclusive.
No Pydantic models for attendance/leave/barter bodies — raw dicts accepted; all numeric coercion and field validation is ad-hoc. Add request models to match the style of IncomeCreate/ExpenseCreate.
server.py 3121 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline, split into FastAPI routers.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates: 1 TEST employee (auto-deleted in fixture teardown), TEST attendance rows on 2026-01-05/06/10/11/12 (deleted in TestCleanup), 1 TEST leave-request (deleted), 2 TEST barters (deleted). No residual TEST_-prefixed data should remain after suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Attendance upsert key is (employee_id, date) string. Leave approval auto-fills attendance with status 'Məzuniyyət' unless leave.type=='Xəstəlik' in which case 'Xəstəlik'. Barter stats exclude counts from 'Təklif'/'Müzakirədə'/'Ləğv edilib' for our/their value sums — only Aktiv + Tamamlandı contribute to totals. RBAC permission keys: 'hr' for attendance + leave-requests, 'finance' for barters. Frontend data-testid: attendance-page, tab-daily/monthly/leaves, date-picker, prev-day-btn, next-day-btn, mark-all-btn, export-daily-btn, month-picker, export-monthly-btn, add-leave-btn, submit-leave-btn, approve-{id}, status-select-{empId}, stat-{status}, att-row-{empId}; barter-page, add-barter-btn, export-barter-btn, submit-barter-btn, status-{barterId}, barter-{barterId}, stat-total/active/our-value/their-value/balance; sidebar menu-attendance, menu-barter.
rca of the issue: No active bug. All flows green. Reported items are minor hardening recommendations and accessibility a11y warnings, not functional regressions.
